 R/o Village Alagwas, P.s. - Karela, District Bhilwara (Raj.)
 ----Petitioners  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Kanchan D/o Shri Pratap Ji, B/c Balai, R/o Village  Alagwas, P.s. - Kareda, District Bhilwara (Raj.)
 ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. K.L Chauhan

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 19/05/2023 The instant misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner for quashing of FIR No.0068/2023, Police Station Kareda, District Bhilwara for offences under Sections 452, 323, 354,
365, 344 & 376 D of IPC.

Learned Public Prosecutor submitted a report dated 18.05.2023 received from SHO, Police Station Kareda, District Bhilwara, wherein it has been mentioned that after through investigation Police is going to submit a Final Report in this case.
The report is hereby taken on record.

[2023/RJJD/016269] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-2157/2023] In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the present misc. petition has become infructuous and dismissed accordingly.
Stay petition also stands dismissed.
